periods.time: Seven Stars first round, B-block fourth match

name.zh: 史黛菈B区四对一特别战

periods.location: Osaka Bay Area, Bay Dome arena
periods.summary: Stella faces Mikoto Tsuruya plus Akatsuki representatives Yui Tatara, Rinna Kazamatsuri/Charlotte and Reisen Hiraga in an unprecedented four-on-one match, defeating every opponent and effectively conquering B-block at once.
periods.cause: Stella arrives late, then uses the delay as grounds to propose a special rule so Akatsuki fighters cannot advance by avoiding each other and forfeiting internally after the Hagun attack.
periods.process: Tatara and Rinna first knock Stella out of bounds, but Stella proves their ordinary attacks cannot harm her. Stella shatters her own wrist against Tatara's Complete Reflection but still finishes a liver blow. She counters Mikoto's absolute-zero Deadly Ice Smile with flame, routs Rinna's lion through draconic pressure, and then fights Charlotte's shield flowers. After welding her broken arm with her own fire, Stella uses consecutive Dragon King Flames to overwhelm Charlotte and Rinna. Hiraga then deploys Deus Ex Machina and Marionette through a controlled Mikoto, forcing the battle into its final phase.
periods.outcome: Tatara, Rinna, Charlotte, Mikoto and Hiraga's puppet body are defeated; Stella remains the only standing contestant.
periods.aftermath: Tatara is medically unable to continue, Rinna withdraws, and Hiraga is disqualified because the real body never entered the field; Stella advances directly to the semifinals.
casualties: Tatara unconscious with severe abdominal trauma
Stella's left wrist/arm shattered then self-fused
Mikoto endangered by neural puppet control
periods.significance: Shows Stella's post-training leap, Akatsuki's dirty tactics, and the commercial/tournament consequences of a single fighter clearing an entire block early.
